status_definitions.partial_manual_native_qualified: Existing finite original/recovered/emitted and native source-host evidence; NOT automatically lifted whole family.
status_definitions.partial_automatic_typed_ready: At least one automatic package with typed ports; does NOT close parent family.
status_definitions.static_causal_target: Own-ROM export traced to actual mechanic/state/service dependencies; no new native executable qualification.
status_definitions.unknown_not_recovered: No sufficient own-ROM executable evidence currently recorded. Candidate names are investigation obligations, not claims of recovered mechanics.
status_definitions.coverage_complete: Requires defended mode/state/transition/dependency/data/persistence and native acceptance closure, never helper count.

new_causal_qualification.limits: Death timer, life decrement/signals and fall integration only. External completion consumption, retry/game-over scene and persistence unresolved. Not idempotent.
